seo.title: About Saltbush Fencing Co. | Family-run WA Fencing Since 2009
seo.description: Family-run fencing contractor with nine in-house crews, yards in Osborne Park and Bunbury, and a 10-year workmanship warranty.

sections.heading: A family business that just happens to build a lot of fences
sections.subheading: Started in 2009 with one ute in Osborne Park. Today: nine in-house crews, two yards and 14,800+ fences across Western Australia.

image.alt: Lawn and fence behind a family home

sections.heading: Named after a plant that thrives where others don't
paragraphs: Saltbush grows in salty, dry, wind-blasted country where almost nothing else survives. That's the standard we hold our fences to: built for coastal salt, 40-degree summers and winter storms.
We never subcontract installs. Every crew is employed by us, trained by us and accountable to us — which is why we can put a 10-year workmanship warranty on every job.
From a single Colorbond boundary to a 400-metre mine-site perimeter, we treat every fence like it's going around our own backyard.

image.alt: Trees along a timber-look boundary fence

items.title: Prices you can trust
items.description: Every price includes GST and every quote lists exactly what's in and what's not.

items.title: No subcontractors
items.description: In-house crews only, so the people who quote are the people who answer the phone later.

items.title: 10-year warranty
items.description: Our workmanship warranty sits on top of BlueScope and manufacturer guarantees.

items.title: Tidy sites
items.description: Old fencing is recycled wherever possible and we leave every site cleaner than we found it.

sections.heading: Come and see us
sections.subheading: Visit the Osborne Park showroom to see every fence style and colour in person — or book a measure and we'll come to you.
